name: Raw Material Production
description: These are the [buildings|e] that allow us to access to [raw_materials|e] we may not have enough access to.

name: Basic Industry
description: These are the [buildings|e] that create [goods|e] that are primarily used by other [buildings|e].

name: Weapons Industry
description: These are the [buildings|e] that create [goods|e] that are used for military purposes.

name: Consumer Goods
description: These are the [buildings|e] that create [goods|e] that are primarily used by [pops|e].

name: Government Buildings
description: These are buildings that are directly controlled by the government and that make it stronger.

name: Infrastructure Buildings
description: These are buildings that improve the value of the location where they are built.

name: Religious Buildings
description: These are buildings devoted to religion and that affect the influence of our clergy in the realm.

name: Cultural Buildings
description: These are buildings that help us educate our unenlightened population or elevate our culture.

name: Trade Buildings
description: These are buildings that improve our national trade, helping our traders to be more efficient or enter new markets.

name: Naval Buildings
description: There are buildings devoted to building [ships|e] and/or improving our [natural_harbor_suitability|e].

name: Military Buildings
description: There are buildings devoted to raising military units in the location.

name: Defensive Buildings
description: These are buildings devoted to the defense of the location and that can affect neighboring ones too.

name: Villages
description: These are the villages we can build in the countryside.

name: Colonial Buildings
description: These are buildings that can be built in foreign unoccupied locations and that help us expand our influence there.

name: Estate Buildings
description: These are buildings that the [estates|e] build for their own benefits.
